warnings.message: pnpm loads .pnpmfile.mjs and names updateConfig at line 2, and the updateConfig hook of a pnpmfile can change every setting after pnpm has read its configuration files, so depcurfew cannot verify the settings it checks

pnpm loads the pnpmfile of the config dependency @pnpm/plugin-better-defaults (configDependencies in pnpm-workspace.yaml, line 2) because of its name, and its updateConfig hook can change every setting after pnpm has read its configuration files, so depcurfew cannot verify the settings it checks; @pnpm/plugin-better-defaults 0.3.0 and later sets minimumReleaseAge: 1440 and blockExoticSubdeps: true
